groups.title: GSM8K case study, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
groups.note: The five recorded runs behind the paper: 11 rounds, 200 evaluation items, decoding changes at round 4 and the extractor at round 8.

groups.title: Smoke run
groups.note: One short run recorded with driftaudit run on an M1 laptop: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, 40 GSM8K items, 4 rounds, one seed. It shows the recorder working from start to finish. Its accuracy figures are not results of the paper.
